gaps_attempted.notes: Search revealed useful market context: 11BF3 (boron-11 trifluoride) is commercially produced at semiconductor scale by 3M, URENCO (15 MT/year of 99.99% enrichment from Dutch facility), and Chinese producers. The semiconductor industry is the primary commercial driver for enriched B-11. Pricing of ~$15,000/kg for 11BF3 appeared in one search summary but could not be traced to an accessible credible primary source. Note: LPPFusion uses decaborane (B10H14), not BF3 — the compound synthesis step adds additional cost beyond isotopic enrichment. No accessible source with quantitative commercial pricing for enriched decaborane specifically was found.

gaps_attempted.notes: Search context from summaries (not primary sources): GaAs PCSS lifetimes range from ~10^4 shots (UWB-HPM applications at higher current) to ~10^8 shots (electro-optic drivers at 20A/5ns pulses). Diamond is expected to substantially exceed GaAs lifetime due to superior thermal conductivity (2100 W/m·K) and critical field (10 MV/cm). Commercial readiness: Opcondys Inc. (LLNL licensee) is developing commercial diamond PCSS under DOE ULTRAFAST funding — pre-commercial as of available information. The OSTI PCSS lifetime testing paper (biblio/1147822) is the most directly relevant source but was inaccessible as a binary PDF. Gap remains partially addressed — no direct diamond PCSS lifetime data found.
